## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Technology and Financials are weak while Real Estate, Utilities and Industrials are notably strong, and leadership is concentrated in Real Estate — these mixed signals justify NEUTRAL.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Real Estate lead: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: EXC (1W: +9.36% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND, AEP (1W: +8.42% | 1M: +10.89%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials showing strength: CAT (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +21.49%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -3.96%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.18%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: JPM (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -1.73%) BELOW TREND, C (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft: BKNG (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND.

Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Real Estate).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND; AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY; CCI (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND; TMUS (1W: +11.20% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Real Estate) and concentrated.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SCHW (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -7.73%) BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -29.51%) BELOW TREND; IBM (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -14.61%) BELOW TREND; C (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Financials and select Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +11.20% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND. Note ORCL and EL (EL (1W: +8.82% | 1M: -7.42%) RECOVERY) show 1W/1M divergence — tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is mixed-to-weak with net selling: AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.18%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -12.64%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Technology ~ 6/19 positive (Internal Rotation).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are under pressure with notable weakness: JPM (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -1.73%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%) CORRECTION, WFC (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -2.06%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Financials ~ 4/20 positive (Sector Weakness).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed/defensive: JNJ (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +11.39%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.98% | 1M: -12.47%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare ~ 6/15 positive (Internal Rotation).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to Real Estate and Utilities names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND strength (EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AEP (1W: +8.42% | 1M: +10.89%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to weak Financials and big-cap Tech that are BELOW TREND (AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -7.73%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -7.73%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Real Estate (Real Estate ~ 5/6 positive) and Utilities (Utilities ~ 5/6 positive) given earnings/news flow. BEARISH: Technology (Technology ~ 6/19 positive) and Financials (Financials ~ 4/20 positive) as downside breadth persists.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
EQIX breakout continuation to validate ABOVE TREND momentum; ORCL must hold recent support after RECOVERY (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%) to confirm reversal; AAPL downside follow-through would deepen Tech weakness; JPM weakness staying below recent support would extend Financials pain.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMAT (+80): AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming. EL (+75): EL (1W: +8.82% | 1M: -7.42%) RECOVERY — sentiment bullish but 1M divergence. AEP (+60): AEP (1W: +8.42% | 1M: +10.89%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming. EQIX (+60): EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (-80): JNJ (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +11.39%) ABOVE TREND — strong price despite negative headline (divergence). AMT (-60): AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND — negative news but price confirming strength (divergence). UNH (-50): UNH (1W: +5.98% | 1M: -12.47%) RECOVERY — sentiment aligns with earnings concerns and 1M weakness. MA (-45): MA (1W: -5.54% | 1M: -5.20%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price confirming pressure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND and CAT (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +21.49%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: concentrated Real Estate leadership and Tech/Financial dispersion—watch bearish headlines on JNJ/UNH vs. strong price action in EQIX/AMT for sentiment divergence.
